tools.name: search_catalogue
tools.description: Find products by name, model or type (Lithuanian or model names work best, e.g. "marškinėliai", "kojinės", "MAIA"). Returns up to 20 products that can be ordered now.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Name, description, price, link and images of one product.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Every size/colour combination of a product with combination_id, price and whether it can be ordered. Pass combination_id to add_line.

tools.name: get_size_guide
tools.description: The shop's size tables (body measurements per size) as text, with a link.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Creates an empty cart. Returns cart_token (keep it for the other cart tools) and checkout_url (give it to the person: they finish and pay on macron.lt).

tools.name: add_line
tools.description: Adds a quantity of a product (and combination, for products with sizes or colours) to the cart. At most 10 of one item and 50 in total.

tools.name: set_quantity
tools.description: Sets the quantity of a cart line; 0 removes it.

tools.name: remove_line
tools.description: Removes a line from the cart.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Lines, prices and total of the cart, and the checkout_url for the person.
